value.rationale: The natural conductance-budget optimization has an exact unexpected support transition: with equal prices the unique optimum uses wheel rim edges for 3–5 peripheral vertices, has nonunique choices at six, and necessarily deletes all rim edges for seven or more. Strict-side unrestricted rigidity and an \(n^{-2}\) price sensitivity law extend beyond an orbit-restricted numerical calculation and give usable network-design thresholds.
